name: Barker
label: Smalltown Supersound
lede: Sam Barker found a Pro-One in his school studio in 1996, booked other people's tours in Berlin for about a decade, then took the kick drum out of techno. His 2025 album Stochastic Drift landed at No. 14 on Pitchfork's year-end list.

eras.title: Voltek before Barker
eras.text: Sam Barker learned electronics on a synth in his school studio, then studied in Brighton and ran a weekly improv night. He recorded as Voltek before the name Barker existed.

years.src: Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst · Tone Glow 185: Barker · The Ransom Note: Transcending Boundaries, Barker & Baumecker Talk
years.h: Barker finds a Sequential Circuits Pro-One in his school's studio
years.p: Sam Barker told Groove that was how he found electronic music, in 1996.
years.xp: Barker told Tone Glow the same origin story: analog synthesis, via that Pro-One, at school. The Ransom Note adds that he grew up playing several instruments and had started electronic productions by 13.

years.src: Tone Glow 185: Barker · AllMusic: Barker biography · DJ Mag: Barker: The paradise engineer
years.h: Every week in Brighton, Barker runs an improv night
years.p: Instrumentality ran from about 2001 to 2006, after he studied digital music in Brighton and joined its experimental scene.
years.xp: AllMusic says he studied in Brighton and recorded under the name Voltek, hoarding analog synthesizers. DJ Mag notes the Voltek records were experimental and IDM-leaning. The name survives: he now builds instruments and installations under Voltek Labs.

eras.title: Berlin, with a day job
eras.text: Barker moved to Berlin for a booking-agency job. At an Autechre show he met Andreas Baumecker, and the two went on to found Leisure System. For nearly a decade he made records around the booking work.

years.src: AllMusic: Barker biography · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst · DJ Mag: Barker: The paradise engineer
years.h: Barker takes a booking-agency job and moves to Berlin
years.p: He made the move in 2007, alongside Ned Beckett.
years.xp: DJ Mag puts his booking years at roughly 2006 to 2016. AllMusic and Groove both date the move to 2007.

years.src: AllMusic: Barker biography · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst
years.h: An Autechre gig puts Barker in a room with Andreas Baumecker
years.p: Barker met Panorama Bar resident [[Andreas Baumecker|7e74456b-e99c-411d-9cd1-041621612d21]] in 2008 while organizing an [[Autechre|410c9baf-5469-44f6-9852-826524b80c61]] gig. Leisure System, run with [[Ned Beckett|e4f8a11c-36c9-43fc-b675-cd15e8f6f43c]], grew out of the same year.
years.xp:
AllMusic says Barker and Beckett founded Leisure System in 2008 and it became a party series and a label for experimental dance music. Groove's account has Baumecker bringing dance-floor structure while Barker brought production chops.

The night's early aim was to widen Berghain's booking beyond minimal techno. Groove says it slowly slipped in other tempos and acts such as Venetian Snares and Flying Lotus.

years.src: AllMusic: Barker biography · DJ Mag: Barker: The paradise engineer
years.h: The first record under his own name is the Like an Animal EP
years.p: AllMusic dates Barker's solo debut to 2012.
years.xp: DJ Mag dates his first Barker EP on Leisure System to 2013. The date is disputed between sources, so the card sticks to AllMusic's year and leaves out the month.

years.cap: Flyer for the LS.X Leisure System night at Berghain, with Barker & Baumecker live
years.src: The Ransom Note: Transcending Boundaries, Barker & Baumecker Talk · NovaFuture Blog: Barker & Baumecker, Turns
yt: Barker & Baumecker live, Boiler Room Berlin
years.p: The second album for Berghain's own label, Ostgut Ton. Baumecker had been DJing as nd_baumecker since the early 1990s.
years.xp: The Ransom Note lists Transsektoral as their first album and Turns as the second, on Ostgut Ton. NovaFuture posted the release in October 2016. The duo also played a Boiler Room Berlin session for Ostgut Ton.

years.src: DJ Mag: Barker: The paradise engineer · Tone Glow 185: Barker
years.h: Ten years of booking end, and Barker says why
years.p: That is how he described the music industry when he left his agency job at the end of 2016.
years.xp: DJ Mag dates the exit to the end of 2016 after about ten years as a booker. Tone Glow's timeline puts his move to full-time production in 2017.

eras.title: Techno with the kick drum taken out
eras.text: On Ostgut Ton, Barker dropped the four-on-the-floor kick and got better reviews for it. Utility made him a solo name.

years.src: DJ Mag: Barker: The paradise engineer · Resident Advisor: Barker biography
years.h: Debiasing drops the kick and lands on year-end lists
years.p: Four tracks on Ostgut Ton (O-TON 112) that get dancers moving without the drum they expect.
years.xp: DJ Mag says the EP's kick-free, soaring synths landed on numerous year-end lists. It set the template for the debut album the next year.

years.src: CDM: Barker, Berghain resident, has found his voice · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst · Resident Advisor: Barker biography
yt: Against the Clock: ten minutes in Barker's Berlin studio
years.h: Utility goes after the law of the instrument
years.p: Barker took the pull of the four-on-the-floor kick as his target and made a debut album largely without one.
years.xp:
CDM reports the record borrows from Abraham Kaplan's The Conduct of Inquiry. Groove names Alex Samuels as a mentor who backed the beatless approach. RA's biography says Mixmag named it its Album of the Year.

Barker told CDM: "I'm not that patient anymore." He now edits far less than he did.

eras.title: A mechanical piano and a new label
eras.text: Touring stopped and Ostgut Ton went on hold. Barker started building machines and moved his solo work to Smalltown Supersound.

years.src: Tone Glow 185: Barker · Bandcamp Daily: Barker, Stochastic Drift
years.h: A mechanical piano gets played in Berghain's downstairs toilet
years.p: Barker and coder Kay Sievers built the piano; it was later performed there.
years.xp: Tone Glow's timeline dates a mechanical-piano installation at Berghain to 2021 to 2022, after the 2020 pandemic wiped out tours and put the label on hold. Bandcamp Daily says the piano is the source of the album track "Fluid Mechanics".

years.cap: Sam Barker in his home studio, in front of the modular rig
years.src: First Floor: In a volatile world, Barker is trying · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst
years.p: Made with Detroit percussionist [[Ray7|7d62cc34-88f0-427e-93f0-c7c7c8268eb5]], it was Barker's first release for Smalltown Supersound.
years.xp: First Floor says Unfixed explored kick drums, a change from the beatless Utility, and that the switch was prompted by pandemic-era label pauses. Groove describes Ray7 as an Underground Resistance percussionist and the pair's solenoid project Packard Plant.

eras.title: Five years, in order
eras.text: Stochastic Drift is sequenced as a diary of five years of chaos, hope and despair. Pitchfork put it in its top 15 of the year.

years.h: "Reframing" goes out two months ahead of the album

years.src: Wikipedia: Stochastic Drift (album) · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst · Bandcamp Daily: Barker, Stochastic Drift · Tone Glow 185: Barker
yt: In the Studio with Barker: making Stochastic Drift
years.h: Stochastic Drift, five years of diary in eight tracks
years.p: Forty-three minutes, all Barker. Pitchfork's Harry Tafoya gave it 8.6; Metacritic lists an 85 from five critics.
years.xp:
Wikipedia lists the album as released April 3, 2025; Tone Glow says April 4. It was built over five years. Groove calls it "a diary of the last five years" with tracks in chronological order. The title comes from probability theory, and Barker cites Nassim Nicholas Taleb's Antifragile as a thematic spark.

AllMusic's Paul Simpson wrote that it sounds like a live drummer playing along to Barker's electronics. Tafoya described a synthesis between chaos and mediated technology.

years.src: Smalltown Supersound: Barker is Pitchfork's 14th Best Album of 2025 · Wikipedia: Stochastic Drift (album) · Groove: Barker, Ich mache mir meine Probleme selbst
yt: Barker on Berghain, AI and the club closures (Resident Advisor)
years.h: Pitchfork puts Stochastic Drift at No. 14 for 2025
years.p: Smalltown Supersound announced the placing on December 2, 2025.
years.xp: Pitchfork's review score was 8.6, by Harry Tafoya. In his April interview with Groove, Barker said: "I make myself my own problems."
